memories.content: Bill is a neighbor who shares a fence with the Osei family. The fence was damaged in a recent storm. Bill believes the cost should be split equally, but is open to negotiation. He wants to avoid small claims court.

A shared fence between Bill's property and the Osei family's property was damaged in a storm. Both parties are aware of the damage and have discussed it briefly. They have two months to reach an agreement on a cost split, or the matter may go to small claims court.
